tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background and the note being read or edited. Papyrus in light, warm ink in dark.

tokens.name: side
tokens.usage: Folder tree sidebar and headers of secondary blocks.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Right panel (comments, links, outline).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, command palette and alerts.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Text field background.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers and card borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of secondary buttons and fields: the outline of what can be pressed.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Tag background and loading skeletons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text on bg, surface and panel. Cream in dark, never pure white, for long writing sessions.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary reading text: alert bodies, search snippets.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Paths, field labels, unselected tree items.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Times, metadata and help text. 12px minimum.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Lapis lazuli: links, the primary action and everything an agent does (diamond, highlight).

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Text on accent-soft (selected note, agent name).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tree selection, active result and highlight of what an agent just wrote.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent (primary button).

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background of alerts, ambiguous links and commented text.

tokens.name: warn-soft-2
tokens.usage: Background of a large alert band (note deleted outside vihko).

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Text on warn-soft and warn-soft-2.

tokens.name: warn-strong
tokens.usage: Alert icons and ambiguous links on bg.

tokens.name: warn-line
tokens.usage: Border of alerts that need a decision.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Saved to disk, insertions in a preview.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Broken link, deletions in a preview, destructive action.

tokens.name: on-user
tokens.usage: Initial on a person's colour. Person colours are not tokens: they are generated (see Presencia).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Scrim under dialogs and side menus.

styles.name: note-body
styles.sample: The index lives on the server and is rebuilt from the files.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: “use Postgres with a table per type…”
styles.usage: Quoted text in a comment or a search.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Default interface text, buttons and tree.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: States, times and hints. Never below 12px.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Links in previews, paths, frontmatter, shortcuts.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a small icon and text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons and between tags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding of compact cards and the tree.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of large buttons and panels.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks of a screen.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top margin of the note.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Side margin of the note on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges and keys.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, tree items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and alerts.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and single-screen forms.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags and the agent presence pill.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Only dialogs and the command palette. Nothing else has a shadow.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Tabs and icon buttons inside panels.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Header icon buttons and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Dialog buttons and fields.

tokens.name: control-xl
tokens.usage: Primary action of a screen (first start).

tokens.name: touch
tokens.usage: Minimum of any touch target on mobile.
